bias.en: Bearish · rejected at the SAR, back under the 200-day
bias.zh: 偏空 · 受阻于 SAR，跌回 200 日均线下方

read.en: ASML fell 6.6% on Oct 30 to $1,565.90, trading between $1,535.33 and $1,609.26 on 1.4 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($1,626.2), falling 10-day ($1,621.8), rising 30-day ($1,714.9), falling 100-day ($1,742.8) and rising 200-day ($1,597.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,690.10), and RSI is 38.5.

The $1,690.1 Oct 29 high met the SAR, and the drop broke all three written supports ($1,597–1,657, incl. the 200-day), now resistance. Resistance is $1,597–1,609 (200-day, Oct 30 high), then $1,621.8–1,626.2 (10 and 5-day) and $1,688–1,690. Support is $1,530.6–1,550 (recent and Jul 29 lows), then $1,493.5 (Jan 28 high) and $1,441.3 (May 19 low). A close above $1,609 would target $1,622–1,626; below $1,530, $1,494.

r.en: Oct 21 and Oct 29 highs ($1,687.8–1,690.1); Parabolic SAR
